repos_data.description: Use your phone's Face ID or fingerprint to approve sudo and unlock your Mac. QR pairing, encrypted BLE, Secure Enclave signing — keys never leave your phone. Works with iPhone, Android, Apple Watch, Wear OS, or any browser. No $199 Magic Keyboard needed.
Turn a Mac mini into a living-room retro/PS console - beautiful big-picture launcher (Electron + React)

Open-source RDP server for macOS. Use your Mac mini or Mac Studio from a MacBook, Windows, iPad or Linux with stock Windows App, mstsc or FreeRDP. Hardware H.264, virtual displays at the client's resolution, audio and clipboard. LAN-only by default, no cloud. Rust (IronRDP) and Swift.
